---
title: "xusplit"
---

## Description

Split long text variable into multiple shorter sub-variables.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`invar`**

: Name of the input variable to split

  *Required:* Yes

**`outds`**

: Name of the output dataset

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `&inds`

**`prefix`**

: Prefix for the output variables names

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `&invar`

**`len`**

: Length of the output variables

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `200`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xusplit(cm,cmdecod);
%xusplit(dv1,temn,outds=dv,prefix=dvterm);
```
